# command line

def parse_arguments(argv):
    """Return ('plan', manifest) or ('replay', manifest, responses).

    Every token equal to -h or --help is reserved and rejected, wherever it
    appears, including after a "--" separator.  There is no help mode.
    """
    for token in argv:
        if token == "-h" or token == "--help":
            raise UserError("help switches are not supported: no help mode")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ipv6_replay.py", add_help=False,
        description="Offline synthetic IPv6 planner and replay reconciler.")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    plan_parser = subparsers.add_parser("plan", add_help=False)
    plan_parser.add_argument("manifest")
    replay_parser = subparsers.add_parser("replay", add_help=False)
    replay_parser.add_argument("manifest")
    replay_parser.add_argument("responses")
    parsed = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if parsed.command == "plan":
        return ("plan", parsed.manifest)
    return ("replay", parsed.manifest, parsed.responses)


def main(argv):
    try:
        arguments = parse_arguments(argv[1:])
        if arguments[0] == "plan":
            result = command_plan(arguments[1])
        else:
            result = command_replay(arguments[1], arguments[2])
    except UserError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("ipv6_replay: %s\n" % (exc,))
        return 2
    except (OSError, ValueError, RecursionError, MemoryError,
            UnicodeError, ArithmeticError, AttributeError, KeyError,
            TypeError, IndexError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("ipv6_replay: %s: %s\n"
                         % (type(exc).__name__, exc))
        return 2
    text = json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False,
                      ensure_ascii=True)
    sys.stdout.write(text)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
